summary.text: Jim Thorne is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 35 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran who served from 1983 to 2003, he lives in Carmel, Maine.

paragraphs.text: Jim Thorne was born in Portland, Maine, and lives in Carmel, Maine.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1983 to 2003.

His career experience includes working as advertising sales manager of the Northwoods Sporting Journal, as a relocation consultant with Parker K. Bailey/United Van Lines, and as a registered Maine Guide.
Thorne has been affiliated with American Legion Post 107, the NRA, B.P.O.E. (Elks) #1954, the Sportsman's Alliance of Maine, Bangor Troop Greeters, and Maine Outdoors.
Ballotpedia lists Thorne's tenure in the Maine House as beginning in 2020, with the current District 35 seat assumed on December 6, 2022.
He was assigned to the Judiciary and Marine Resources committees in 2021-2022, and to the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee and the Marine Resources Committee, as ranking member, in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
